text: Alex drops new ideas into chat mid-build ('I'll just post it in here and you can take it where it needs to go'); route each to the right lane or session without stopping to ask.
In data-heavy UIs Alex wants abstract numbers made tangible and fun (value in booster boxes, odds as boxes to open): 'add tangibility to what is intangible or obtuse anywhere we can'.
For personal tools Alex wants features that save time or give a real edge, not a dashboard restating what he already knows.
